mapper.sql: SELECT cc.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, ct.name AS card_type_name FROM customer_card cc JOIN customer c ON c.id = cc.customer_id JOIN card_type ct ON ct.id = cc.card_type_id
mapper.select: WHERE cc.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY cc.id DESC

where.if: AND (c.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.phone LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR cc.card_no LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_card WHERE card_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_card(card_no, customer_id, card_type_id, paid_qty, gift_qty, used_paid, used_gift, paid_amount_cent, issued_on, expire_on, status, source_bill_id, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{cardNo}, #{customerId}, #{cardTypeId}, #{paidQty}, #{giftQty}, 0, 0, #{paidAmountCent}, #{issuedOn}, #{expireOn}, #{status}, #{sourceBillId}, #{remark}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_card SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE customer_card SET expire_on = #{expireOn}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE customer_card SET source_bill_id = #{billId} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE customer_card SET used_gift = used_gift + CASE WHEN (gift_qty - used_gift) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, used_paid = used_paid + CASE WHEN (gift_qty - used_gift) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id = #{cardId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_on >= #{today} AND (paid_qty - used_paid + gift_qty - used_gift) > 0

UPDATE customer_card SET used_paid = used_paid + CASE WHEN (paid_qty - used_paid) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, used_gift = used_gift + CASE WHEN (paid_qty - used_paid) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id = #{cardId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_on >= #{today} AND (paid_qty - used_paid + gift_qty - used_gift) > 0
UPDATE customer_card SET used_gift = used_gift - #{qty} WHERE id = #{cardId} AND used_gift >= #{qty}
UPDATE customer_card SET used_paid = used_paid - #{qty} WHERE id = #{cardId} AND used_paid >= #{qty}
